description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Chocobo Love Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Chocobo Love Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 50% more damage, instant cast speed for Fire abilities, casts Giga Flame Follow-Up after using 3 Fire abilities, removed after casting Giga Flame Follow-Up  one time
